categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, production, and sales of copper-clad laminates, prepregs, and printed circuit boards (PCBs). It also involves resource recycling and environmental protection services. Its products serve high-performance electronic materials markets including AI servers, 5G antennas, communication base stations, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in high-frequency, high-speed laminates, metal-based copper-clad laminates, and environmentally friendly materials. It emphasizes proprietary R&D in ultra-low loss resins, copper foil technologies, and high thermal conductivity substrates. Manufacturing processes include precision layering, high-temperature curing, and lean production with digital management systems like MES and PLM.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in AI servers, 5G communications, automotive electronics, aerospace, chip packaging, industrial control, medical devices, and consumer electronics. The company serves global high-end electronics markets with a focus on high-performance and reliable PCB materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, and other provinces. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Thailand. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with significant exports and overseas customer development, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing core electronic materials such as copper-clad laminates and prepregs used by PCB manufacturers. It does not engage in upstream raw material mining or downstream final product assembly but focuses on supplying essential materials to PCB fabricators and electronic component manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the copper-clad laminate business, expanding high-end product lines like HDI and high-frequency laminates, and enhancing overseas market penetration. R&D focuses on next-generation server platforms, 5G high thermal conductivity materials, high-reliability HDI substrates, metal-based substrates, and materials for AI and satellite communications. The company also invests in digital transformation and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of copper-clad laminates, prepregs, and printed circuit boards. The company employs direct sales and distributor channels, with a focus on fulfilling customer orders promptly. It also earns income from resource recycling services and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks second globally in rigid copper-clad laminate sales with a 14% market share, competing with top global suppliers. It holds a strong position in high-end electronic materials and is recognized for its technological innovation and quality certifications. The company emphasizes brand strength, technical leadership, and comprehensive product portfolios to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 20.39 billion, a 22.92% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.74 billion, up 49.37%. Total assets reached RMB 27.64 billion, growing 10.77%. The company maintains steady growth with increased R&D investment and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-standard, high-quality, high-performance, and highly reliable electronic materials tailored to meet end-user functional demands. It differentiates through proprietary technology, comprehensive product certifications, and strong customer service. Its focus on innovation, quality control, and flexible pricing strategies enables it to meet diverse customer needs in emerging and traditional markets.
